what: Akamai runs servers in thousands of locations worldwide so that websites load from somewhere near the user. That same network now also blocks attacks and runs customers' code at the edge.
customers: Media companies, retailers, banks and software firms whose sites must be fast and must stay up.
money: bot defence, web application firewalls and DDoS protection
cloud computing run close to users
moat: A network of servers inside thousands of internet providers, placed over 25 years, which cannot be replicated by renting cloud capacity.
risks: The original delivery business is in structural decline as bandwidth prices fall
Cloudflare competes aggressively on price in security, where Akamai makes its profit
Revenue grows only in the low single digits, from $4.0B to $4.2B last year
opportunities: $545M of free cash flow and analysts see about 40% upside, with 22 covering the stock
Security is now the largest segment and grows at double digits
$1.2B of cash against $1.6B of debt, and the company buys back stock steadily
watch: Security and compute revenue growth against the decline in delivery.
